If every merge to main ships automatically, there is no separate release step. **Merging to main is the release.** You don't push a `vYYYY.MM.N` tag anymore.

- **Before merging:** the PR is the last checkpoint, so review and CI on the PR matter more than they used to.
- **After merging:** watch the pipeline that runs on main to confirm the deploy succeeded.
- **Rolling back:** revert the change on main and merge the revert. I couldn't find how rollbacks are meant to work here.
- **Not verified:** the repo has no CI or workflow files, so I couldn't confirm any of this. The pipeline presumably lives elsewhere. If you tell me where, I can check the details, such as what gates the deploy.
